notes:
- The Prison is now one fixed map, the same every game (the layout you picked), hand-polished room by room.
  The Mystery Box, wall weapons, events and pickups still move around each game.
- Prison set pieces: a prison transport bus crashed through the yard wall; the infirmary where it all
  started (a torn-open restraint bed, a blood trail, a recording to play); searchlights sweeping the yard and
  courtyard; a riot gate trap that slams down on zombies again and again; a hidden armory behind a
  bricked-up doorway in the guard office (smash it with melee: a free Breacher once a game and an ammo crate
  once a round); a rooftop route, a fire-escape stair and catwalk from the courtyard into a broken-open
  cell on the cell block's upper tier (zombies follow you up); and a Lockdown event that slams the cell
  block gates shut (hold the use button at a gate to force it).
- The world outside the Prison: bins, pallets, generators and parked trucks between the buildings, a road
  round the inside of the wall with lamps and patrol cars, the main gate and guard booth, watchtowers on every
  corner, and pine woods, power lines, a water tower and a distant town beyond the wall.
- Gravity Well, a new wonder weapon in the box: it fires a slow orb that opens a small black hole, drags
  zombies in and crushes them, then collapses with a blast. Tier III, Singularity: it lasts longer, pulls from
  further and spits out what it ate as a ring of explosions.
- Riot shield, a buildable on every map: find its three parts, build it at the workbench, and everyone can
  take one. On your back it blocks hits from behind; hold B (R3 on a controller) to raise it, block the front
  and shield-bash. It breaks after enough hits; take a new one next round.
- Lab side quest, Containment Breach: charge three cooling cores by killing zombies next to them, load
  them at the containment console, hold the room, then put down Subject 9, the failed test subject. Reward:
  5000 XP and the new Contained camo.
- Controller button icons: with a controller, prompts show the real buttons as coloured Xbox icons
  (PlayStation shapes on a PlayStation controller), and the controls help shows the controller layout.
- Difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard and Hardcore on the map screen (the host picks for co-op). Hardcore hides
  most of the HUD.
- Inspect your weapon: hold I to turn it and look at its camo.
- End-of-game summary: kills, headshots, downs, revives, points and more for every player.
- First-game hints: the first time you meet the Mystery Box, a perk, the upgrade machine, a wall weapon, a
  barrier, a door or a trap, a side card says what it does.
- Gun fixes: guns sit a little lower at the hip; the Longshot and Warden zoom in more on their iron sights;
  the Vortex and Hornet iron sights line up properly; the Arc Zapper and Cryo Freezer sights sit on a mount.
